campfire-orange.$description: Campfire Orange — Logo badge, notification pills, and brand-punctuation moments — a single warm coral that anchors the entire palette against the cream canvas

ember-brown.$description: Ember Brown — Deep brown accent for paint-splash illustration shadows and inline highlight text in testimonials

sunlit-cream.$description: Sunlit Cream — Soft warm wash behind tags, badges, and inline highlights

forest-pulse.$description: Forest Pulse — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ember-alert.$description: Ember Alert — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, headings, icon strokes, and dark filled buttons

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, and the top of the surface stack

parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas — a barely-warm off-white that gives the whole site its sunlit feel

fog-gray.$description: Fog Gray — Muted backgrounds, secondary surface fills, and input field chrome

linen.$description: Linen — Subtle dividers, hover wash on rows, and tag backgrounds

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted helper text, placeholder copy, and disabled labels

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, timestamps, and metadata in lists

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text and muted icon strokes

stone.$description: Stone — Warm muted accent for body copy that should feel quieter than Midnight Ink

inter.$description: Sole typeface across UI, headings, and body — no display or serif counterpart. The single-family commitment is deliberate: Inter's geometric neutrality keeps focus on content, and the three-weight range (400 body, 500 metadata, 600 display) carries all hierarchy.

ui-monospace.$description: Inline code fragments and keyboard shortcuts inside the feed

emoji.$description: emoji — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
